purpose: Confirm a caller-supplied JWKS directory document matches a caller-pinned SHA-256 digest (sha256(canonicalize(directory_jwks)) === pinned_digest) before art-130 trusts its shape. Zero network, zero key hosting -- both the document and the digest are caller-supplied. Chains before art-130 in visa-tap-agent-verification.
